content.value_statement: Turborepo setups can become slow, brittle, or hard to debug across many packages. This skill guides clear task design, cache behavior, CI filters, and package structure.
actual_capabilities: Explains how to define package tasks and register them in turbo.json.
Diagnoses common cache misses, missing outputs, and input tracking issues.
Guides environment variable configuration for hashing and runtime pass-through.
Recommends CI patterns using affected packages, filters, and remote cache.
Provides monorepo structure guidance for apps, packages, and shared dependencies.
Clarifies package boundaries, dependency ownership, and task ordering.
limitations: It provides guidance only and does not replace Turborepo documentation for every version.
It cannot verify remote cache provider settings without project access.
It may need repository-specific scripts before recommending exact task names.
It does not audit secret values stored in local environment files.

use_cases.title: Set Up a New Monorepo
use_cases.description: Design apps, packages, package scripts, and turbo tasks before the repository grows.

use_cases.title: Debug Cache Misses
use_cases.description: Find missing outputs, incorrect inputs, and environment variables that affect rebuilds.

use_cases.title: Improve CI Throughput
use_cases.description: Use affected packages, filters, and remote cache to reduce build and test time.

prompt_templates.title: Review My Setup
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of an existing monorepo.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Turborepo setup and identify task, cache, and package structure issues. Start with the safest improvements.

prompt_templates.title: Fix Cache Behavior
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate debugging for unexpected rebuilds or stale outputs.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me debug Turborepo cache misses. Check outputs, inputs, dependencies, environment variables, and task boundaries.

prompt_templates.title: Design CI Tasks
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced CI optimization across many packages.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a CI workflow for this Turborepo using affected packages, filters, remote cache, and clear failure reporting.

prompt_templates.title: Refactor Task Architecture
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced redesign of task pipelines and package ownership.
prompt_templates.prompt: Refactor this Turborepo task architecture. Preserve package boundaries, improve parallelism, and explain migration risks.

output_examples.input: Builds are slow after adding a new shared package.
output: The shared package needs its own build task.
Dependent apps should declare package dependencies clearly.
The app build should depend on upstream package builds.

output_examples.input: A changed environment variable does not trigger a rebuild.
output: Add the variable to the task environment list when it affects output.
Use pass-through only for runtime values that should not affect cache keys.
Track relevant environment files as task inputs when file changes matter.

output_examples.input: CI runs every task for every pull request.
output: Use affected package selection for pull requests.
Keep root scripts as simple turbo run delegations.
Enable remote cache only after credentials and permissions are scoped.

best_practices: Keep task logic inside packages and let root scripts delegate to turbo run.
Declare outputs, inputs, and environment variables explicitly for reliable caching.
Use filters and affected package selection to keep local and CI workflows focused.
anti_patterns: Do not put all build logic in root package scripts.
Do not use broad environment globs when specific variables are known.
Do not rely on remote cache before outputs and inputs are correct.

faq.question: Does this skill execute Turborepo commands?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and examples. Command execution depends on the host assistant and user approval.

faq.question: Can it help with turbo.json?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains tasks, dependencies, outputs, inputs, cache settings, and environment configuration.

faq.question: Can it diagnose cache misses?
faq.answer: Yes. It can review common causes such as missing outputs, ignored inputs, and undeclared environment variables.

faq.question: Does it support CI planning?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers affected package workflows, filters, remote cache, and common CI task layouts.

faq.question: Is it specific to one package manager?
faq.answer: No. It references common npm, pnpm, and yarn patterns where they affect Turborepo behavior.

faq.question: Can it replace project-specific review?
faq.answer: No. Large monorepos still need repository-specific review of scripts, dependencies, and deployment requirements.
